description: This file defines the SendViaApsAck class, which extends SendCommandRequest, representing a specific command to send a message with an APS acknowledgment in a Zigbee simulation environment. It includes logic to notify when an APS acknowledgment is received.

classes.name: SendViaApsAck
classes.description: A request class that sends a command with APS acknowledgment and triggers an event upon acknowledgment reception.

methods.name: SendViaApsAck
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SendViaApsAck instance with request parameters.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Executes the request on a given Zigbee device and notifies the reception of an APS acknowledgment.
